blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
The rapid evolution of video generation has narrowed the perceptual gap between authentic and synthetic videos, making generalizable AI-generated video detection increasingly challenging.
Existing detectors predominantly rely on visual representations, leaving caption-derived textual semantics underexplored.
Meanwhile, temporal regularity in fine-grained visual representations has received limited attention.
We find that caption-derived textual representations provide complementary discriminative cues to global visual representations.
Our analysis further reveals that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and lower temporal variability, a pattern we term temporal over-regularity (TOR).
Based on these findings, we propose MTOR with a multimodal branch and a TOR component.
The multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations, while the TOR component models temporal over-regularity at three levels: coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability.
Extensive evaluations on five benchmarks covering 46 generator variants demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance against 16 representative baselines, while robustness experiments confirm strong resilience to twelve real-world video perturbations.
Code and models will be released. 0 0 0 https://github.com/hwang-cs-ime/MTOR
blocks.zh:
视频生成的快速演变缩小了真视频和合成视频之间的感知差距,使通俗化的AI生成视频检测越来越具有挑战性.
现有的探测器主要依靠视觉表现,使得字幕衍生出文字语义的探讨不足.
同时,精致视觉表现中的时间规律性受到的关注有限.
我们发现,字幕产生的文字表述对全球视觉表述提供了补充性的歧视性提示。
我们的分析进一步揭示出人工智能生成的视频表现出更强的时间持久性和更低的时间可变性,我们称之为时间超常(TOR)的模式.
根据这些调查结果,我们提议建立具有多式联运分支和职权范围组成部分的MTOR。
多式联运分支整合了全球视觉和字幕衍生的文字表达方式,而TOR组件则在三个层面模拟了时间超常现象:粗糙的帧间连续性,细细的纹章对应,和帧到视频的稳定性.
对涵盖46个发电机变体的5个基准的广泛评价显示,相对于16个具有代表性的基线而言,最先进的总体业绩,而强健性实验则证实,对12个真实世界视频扰动具有强大的复原力。
代码和模型将发布。 0 0 0 https://github.com/hwang-cs-ime/MTOR (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
The rapid evolution of generative artificial intelligence has spurred unprecedented breakthroughs in video synthesis.
Driven by scaling laws and advanced diffusion-based architectures, state-of-the-art video generation frameworks such as Sora [ 1 ] , Runway Gen-4 [ 2 ] and Kling [ 3 ] are capable of producing high-fidelity videos with photorealistic visual quality, fluent motion, and coherent spatiotemporal scenes.
These advances have made AI-generated videos increasingly difficult to visually distinguish from authentic videos.
Meanwhile, the widespread availability of these sophisticated generation techniques brings severe societal risks.
Maliciously fabricated videos can easily propagate misinformation [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] , undermine public trust [ 11 , 12 ] in digital media, and even pose potential ethical and security threats.
Consequently, developing a generalizable detection paradigm to identify AI-generated videos has become increasingly important for advancing multimedia forensics and safeguarding societal trust.
blocks.zh:
基因人工智能的迅速演化推动了视频合成的空前突破.
以推广法律和基于传播的先进架构、先进的视频生成框架(如Sora)为动力 [1],"跑道"Gen-4 [2]和克林[3]能够制作出具有相片真实视觉品质,流畅运动,连贯的相片相片.
这些进步使得AI制作的视频与正版视频在视觉上越来越难以区分.
同时,这些尖端的生成技术的广泛提供带来了严重的社会风险。
恶意捏造的视频很容易传播错误信息[4、5、6、7、8、9、10],破坏公众对数字媒体的信任[11、12],甚至构成潜在的道德和安全威胁。
因此,为识别人工智能制作的视频而制定一个普遍的检测范式,对于推进多媒体取证和维护社会信任已变得日益重要。

blocks.en:
To mitigate these threats, recent studies have explored diverse temporal and spatiotemporal modeling strategies for AI-generated video detection.
DeCoF [ 13 ] focuses on inter-frame consistency to capture temporal artifacts that generalize across generators, while ReStraV [ 14 ] analyzes the geometry of visual representation trajectories through temporal curvature and distance.
D3 [ 15 ] further characterizes second-order temporal variation, whereas NSG-VD [ 16 ] models spatiotemporal dynamics through conservation constraints on probability flow.
STALL [ 17 ] takes a probabilistic perspective by jointly modeling spatial likelihoods of individual frames and temporal likelihoods of inter-frame transitions.
Despite these advances, most existing approaches base their predictions primarily on visual representations, leaving caption-derived textual semantics largely unexplored.
Such reliance on visual representations may overlook complementary discriminative cues conveyed by caption-derived textual semantics.
Meanwhile, existing temporal and spatiotemporal methods characterize video dynamics from diverse perspectives, yet the temporal regularities encoded in fine-grained visual representations have not been fully exploited for generalizable detection.
blocks.zh:
为了减轻这些威胁,最近的研究探索了各种时间和瞬间模拟策略,用于AI生成的视频检测.
DeCoF [13] 专注于帧间的一致性来捕捉跨发电机通俗化的时空文物,而ReStraV [14] 通过时间曲率和距离分析视觉表现轨迹的几何.
D3 [15] 进一步定性了二等时间变化,而NSG-VD [16] 模型则通过对概率流的养护限制来分解时态动态.
STALL [17]通过联合模拟单个帧的空间可能性和帧间过渡的时间可能性,从概率角度出发.
尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数现有方法的预测主要以视觉表现为基础,使得字幕衍生出的案文语义基本上没有得到探讨。
这种对视觉表达的依赖可能忽略了由字幕衍生出文字语义传达的补充性歧视提示。
同时,现有的时间和瞬间方法从不同角度对视频动态作了描述,但精细的视觉表现所编码的时间规律尚未被充分利用来进行普遍的检测。

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we investigate AI-generated video detection from two complementary perspectives: video-level multimodal semantics and fine-grained temporal regularity.
First, we examine the contribution of caption-derived textual representations when combined with global visual representations.
Our empirical results show that their combination consistently outperforms either representation alone, indicating that caption-derived semantics provide discriminative cues complementary to visual representations.
Second, we analyze fine-grained visual dynamics at three levels: coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability.
Across these levels, AI-generated videos consistently exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability than real-world videos.
We term this tendency temporal over-regularity (TOR).
blocks.zh:
为解决这些局限性,我们从两个互补角度调查AI生成的视频检测:视频层面的多模式语义和精细的刻度常态.
第一,我们审查由标题衍生的文字表述与全球视觉表述相结合的贡献。
我们的经验结果显示,两者的结合一贯优于单独表述,表明字幕衍生语义为视觉表达提供了补充的歧视性提示。
第二,我们在三个层面分析精细的视觉动态:粗细的相机间连续性,精细的相机信使,和相机到相机的稳定性.
在这些层面,AI制作的视频比现实世界的视频始终表现出更强的时间持久性和较低的时间可变性。
我们把这种倾向称为时间过常。

blocks.en:
Based on these observations, we propose MTOR , a multimodal AI-generated video detector that jointly models video-level M ultimodal semantics and T emporal O ver- R egularity.
Given an input video, a video encoder extracts a global visual representation, while a video captioning model generates a textual description that is subsequently encoded into a global textual representation.
The multimodal branch combines the visual and textual representations to produce a multimodal detection score.
In parallel, the TOR component explicitly models the three levels of temporal regularity using six descriptors that capture the strength and variation of adjacent-frame relations, together with the stability of frame-to-video similarity.
These descriptors are subsequently mapped to a TOR detection score.
Finally, the multimodal and TOR scores are standardized using statistics estimated from the source-training set and fused to obtain the final MTOR score, without requiring any target-domain data.
blocks.zh:
基于这些观察,我们提议MTOR,一种由AI生成的多模式视频探测器,它联合模拟了视频级的Multimodule语义和T emporal O ver-Rularity.
由于一个输入视频,视频编码器提取出一个全局视觉表现,而视频字幕模型则生成一个文字描述,随后被编码为全局文字表现.
多式联运分会结合视觉和文字表现,产生多模式检测分数.
同时,TOR部分还使用六个描述符来明确模拟时间规律的三级,这些描述符可以捕捉相邻框架关系的强度和变异性,以及帧到视频相似性的稳定性.
这些描述符随后被映射到TOR检测分数.
最后,采用从源培训集中估算并连接起来以获得最后的MTOR分数的统计资料,将多式联运和TOR分数标准化,而不需要任何目标领域数据。

blocks.en: In summary, this work makes three key contributions. 1. We propose MTOR, a multimodal framework for generalizable AI-generated video detection. Its multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations derived from the same input video, introducing complementary textual semantics without requiring external textual input. 2. We reveal that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability than real videos, a pattern we term temporal over-regularity (TOR). To model this pattern, we develop a TOR component with six temporal descriptors spanning coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. 3. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks covering 46 video generator variants demonstrate strong cross-generator performance against 16 representative baselines. Ablation and robustness studies further verify the complementarity of the multimodal branch and TOR component, as well as the robustness of MTOR under twelve real-world video perturbations.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,这项工作作出了三项重要贡献。 1. 我们提议MTOR,这是一个通用AI生成视频探测的多模式框架。 其多模式分支整合了来自同一输入视频的全球视觉和字幕衍生的文字表述,引入了互补的文字语义,而不需要外部文字输入. 2. 我们披露,AI生成的视频比真实视频表现出更强的时间持久性和时间可变性,这是我们称之为时间超常的模式。 为了模拟这种模式,我们开发了一个TOR组件,配有6个时间描述符,涵盖粗糙的机体间连续性,细细的纹章通信,以及机框到视频的稳定性. 3. 对涉及46个视频生成器变体的5个基准进行的广泛试验显示,对照16个具有代表性的基准,具有强大的跨源性能。 校正性和稳健性研究进一步验证了多式联运分支和TOR部分的互补性,以及MTOR在12个真实世界视频扰动下的稳健性.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Deepfake Video Detection
blocks.zh: II-A 深假视频检测

blocks.en:
Deepfake video detection has gradually shifted from frame-level artifact analysis toward exploiting temporal and spatiotemporal inconsistencies across video frames.
Early video-based methods therefore focused on exposing inter-frame inconsistencies.
STIL [ 18 ] integrates spatial inconsistencies with adjacent-frame temporal differences, while FTCN [ 19 ] suppresses spatial modeling to emphasize temporal features and captures long-range temporal coherence with a Temporal Transformer.
Subsequent studies further model temporal dependencies over multiple ranges.
MRE-Net [ 20 ] employs multi-rate sampling to capture short- and long-term spatiotemporal inconsistencies, whereas ISTVT [ 21 ] decomposes self-attention into spatial and temporal dimensions and emphasizes inter-frame temporal inconsistencies.
TALL [ 22 ] rearranges consecutive frames into a compact thumbnail for efficient spatiotemporal modeling, while MINTIME [ 23 ] introduces identity-aware modeling for videos containing multiple identities and varying face sizes.
blocks.zh:
深假视频探测逐渐从帧级文物分析转向利用视频帧间的时间和瞬间不一致.
因此,早期的以视频为基础的方法侧重于揭露框架之间的不一致。
STIL [18] 将空间不一致与相邻-帧时间差异相融合,而FTCN [19] 压制空间模型,以强调时间特征并捕捉出与一个Temperal Transformer的长距离时间一致性.
随后的研究进一步在多个范围内模拟时间依赖性.
MRE-Net [20] 采用多分率抽样来捕捉短期和长期的瞬间不一致,而ISTVT [21] 则将自觉分解为空间和时间维度,并强调了时间间不一致.
TALL [22] 将相接相框重排成一个紧凑的缩略图,用于高效的spatiotopal建模,而MINTIME [23] 则引入了包含多个身份和不同面相大小的视频的身份意识建模.

blocks.en:
As deepfake generation techniques become increasingly realistic, improving generalization to unseen manipulations has received growing attention.
AltFreezing [ 24 ] alternately freezes spatial- and temporal-related weights to prevent excessive reliance on either artifact type, while DIP [ 25 ] models directional spatiotemporal inconsistencies and introduces generalization-oriented training strategies.
Beyond conventional RGB-level temporal cues, StyleFlow [ 26 ] analyzes temporal variations of facial style latent vectors, and recent work [ 27 ] extends temporal analysis to the frequency domain.
Yan et al. [ 28 ] identify Facial Feature Drift as a transferable temporal forgery artifact and construct hard negative samples through video-level blending, whereas FakeSTormer [ 29 ] introduces auxiliary spatial and temporal vulnerability branches to improve generalization and interpretability.
Collectively, these studies seek more transferable temporal representations and learning strategies for generalized deepfake detection.
blocks.zh:
随着深层假造技术变得越来越现实,改进通俗化,以隐蔽地进行操纵,受到越来越多的关注.
AltFreezing [24] 交替地冻结了与空间和时间相关的权重,以防止过度依赖任何一种文物类型,而DIP [25] 模型有方向的瞬间不一致,并引入了面向通用的培训策略.
除了常规的RGB级时间提示外,StyleFlow [26] 分析了面部样式潜在向量的时间变化,而最近的工作[27]将时间分析扩展到了频率域.
颜等. [28] 将花纹漂流物确定为可转移的时空伪造文物,并通过视频平面混合构建硬底样本,而假相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
这些研究共同寻求更多可转移的时间表述和学习战略,以进行普遍的深假检测。

blocks.en:
Multimodal cues have also been investigated for deepfake video detection.
Feng et al. [ 30 ] formulate video forensics as self-supervised anomaly detection based on audio-visual synchronization, while AVFF [ 9 ] learns audio-visual correspondences through self-supervised contrastive and reconstruction objectives before supervised fine-tuning.
These studies demonstrate that inconsistencies in audio-visual synchronization and correspondence can help distinguish manipulated from authentic videos.
Nevertheless, most deepfake video detectors are designed for facial manipulation and primarily exploit face-specific spatial, temporal, or audio-visual cues.
Their problem setting therefore differs from open-domain AI-generated video detection, where entire videos may be synthesized by diverse generation models and span a wide range of scenes, objects, actions, and motion patterns.
blocks.zh:
对多模式提示也进行了调查,以进行深假视频检测。
冯等. [30] 将视频法证作为基于视听同步的自我监督异常检测,而AVFF[9]通过自我监督的对比和重建目标来学习视听函证,然后进行监督的微调.
这些研究表明,视听同步和通信方面的不一致有助于区分被操纵和正版视频.
尽管如此,大多数深假视频探测器都是为进行面部操纵而设计的,主要利用相貌特有的空间,时间,或视听提示.
因此,他们的问题设置与开放域AI生成的视频探测不同,整个视频可能由不同的生成模型合成,并跨越了广泛的场景,物品,动作和运动模式.

blocks.en: II-B AI-Generated Video Detection
blocks.zh: II-B AI-Gened Video探测器

blocks.en:
Unlike deepfake detection, which primarily targets facial manipulation, AI-generated video detection addresses fully synthesized videos beyond the facial domain, making generalization to unseen video generators particularly challenging.
Early studies approached this problem by modeling spatial and temporal artifacts in generated videos.
AIGVDet [ 31 ] employs separate RGB and optical-flow branches to capture spatial abnormalities and temporal inconsistencies, respectively, and combines their frame-level predictions through decision-level fusion for video-level detection.
DeMamba [ 32 ] further models local spatiotemporal inconsistencies across different regions using a structured state-space model.
However, spatial artifacts are often generator-specific.
Motivated by this observation, DeCoF [ 13 ] reduces the influence of spatial artifacts during feature learning and focuses on inter-frame consistency to improve generalization to unseen generators.
Together, these studies highlight spatial and temporal artifacts as important forensic cues for AI-generated video detection.
blocks.zh:
与主要针对面部操纵的深假检测不同,AI所生成的视频检测地址在面部域外完全合成了视频,使得通俗化到看不见的视频生成器尤其具有挑战性.
早期的研究通过在生成的视频中建模空间和时间文物来解决这一问题.
AIGVDet [31] 分别使用单独的RGB和光学流分支来捕捉空间异常和时间不一致,并通过决策级聚变来结合其帧级预测来进行视频级检测.
DeMamba [32] 使用结构化的状态-空间模型,进一步模拟不同地区的局部spatiotal不一致.
然而,空间文物往往是发电机特有的.
基于这一观察,DeCoF [13] 减少了空间文物在地物学习过程中的影响力,并注重于框架间的一致性来提高通俗化到看不见的发电机.
这些研究共同强调空间和时间文物是AI生成的视频探测的重要法证提示.

blocks.en:
More recent studies have examined video dynamics from increasingly diverse perspectives.
ReStraV [ 14 ] analyzes frame trajectories in a pretrained visual representation space and characterizes their geometry through temporal curvature and stepwise distance.
D3 [ 15 ] derives second-order temporal features from first-order inter-frame differences and performs training-free detection using statistics of second-order central differences.
In a different direction, NSG-VD [ 16 ] takes a physics-driven approach to modeling spatiotemporal video evolution through conservation constraints on probability flow.
It defines the Normalized Spatiotemporal Gradient (NSG) as the ratio of spatial probability gradients to temporal density changes, and detects AI-generated videos by comparing NSG distributions between test and real videos.
STALL [ 17 ] adopts a training-free probabilistic framework that jointly models the spatial likelihood of individual frames and the temporal likelihood of frame-to-frame transitions.
blocks.zh:
最近的研究从日益多样化的角度审查了视频动态。
ReStraV [14] 在被预先训练的视觉表现空间中分析帧轨迹,并通过时间曲率和相继相距来描述它们的几何特征.
D3 [15] 从一阶间距差异中衍生出二阶时间特征,并使用二阶中央差异的统计进行无培训检测.
在不同的方向上,NSG-VD[16]采用由物理学驱动的方法,通过对概率流的保存限制来模拟spatiotal视频演化.
它将常态化的斯帕蒂奥特梯度(NSG)定义为空间概率梯度与时间密度变化的比值,并通过比较测试和真实视频之间的NSG分布来检测AI生成的视频.
STALL [17]采用无训练概率框架,共同模拟单个帧的空间可能性和帧到帧过渡的时间可能性.

blocks.en:
Overall, existing methods span a wide range of visual-domain formulations, from spatial and temporal artifacts to representation geometry, higher-order dynamics, physics-driven spatiotemporal modeling, and spatial-temporal likelihoods.
In contrast, MTOR extends beyond purely visual formulations by incorporating a caption-derived textual representation of the same video.
It further characterizes temporal over-regularity through coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability.
blocks.zh:
总体来说,现有方法涵盖从空间和时间文物到代表几何,高阶动态,由物理驱动的spatiotal建模,以及空间-时间概率等多种视觉领域配方.
相比之下,MTOR除了纯粹的视觉配方之外,还包含了同一视频的字幕出自文字的表示.
它通过粗糙的帧间连续性、细微的纹章通信以及帧到视频的稳定性,进一步定性了时间超常性。

blocks.en: III Empirical Observations and Motivation
blocks.zh: 三. 经验观察和动机

blocks.en:
This section presents the empirical observations underlying the design of MTOR.
We first examine video-level visual and caption-derived textual representations for AI-generated video detection and show that combining the two improves detection over either representation alone.
We then analyze temporal dynamics reflected in fine-grained visual representations and observe that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability, a tendency we term temporal over-regularity (TOR).
Finally, experiments across five benchmarks show that TOR complements the video-level multimodal representation, motivating the joint modeling of multimodal semantics and temporal over-regularity in MTOR.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍MTOR设计的基本经验观察.
我们首先审查AI生成的视频探测视频的视频视觉和字幕衍生文字表述,并显示两者的结合会改善检测,而不只是两个表述。
然后,我们分析精细视觉表现所反映的时间动态,并观察到AI生成的视频表现出更强的时间持久性并降低时间可变性,我们称之为时间超常(TOR)的倾向.
最后,跨越五个基准的实验表明,职权范围是对视频一级多式联运代表的补充,推动了多式联运语义的联合模型化和MTOR中的时间超常性。

blocks.en: III-A Video-Level Multimodal Representation
blocks.zh: 三-A 视频一级多式联运代表

blocks.en:
To examine the effectiveness of different video-level representations for AI-generated video detection, we evaluate three variants: visual-only, text-only, and a multimodal variant G G that combines the two representations.
Given an input video 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , a pretrained video encoder extracts its global visual representation, which is used by the visual-only variant for authenticity classification.
As reported in Table I , this variant achieves 97.42% AP and 97.04% AUC on GenVideo.
blocks.zh:
为了检查AI生成的视频检测的不同视频级别表示的效果,我们评价了三种变体:只视觉,只文本,以及结合两种表示的多模式变体G.
由于一个输入视频V\mathcal{V},一个预先训练的视频编码器取出其全球可视化的表示,它被只为可视化的变体用于真实分类.
如表一所报告,在GenVideo上,该变体达到97.42%的AP和97.04%的AUC。

blocks.en:
We next examine the caption-derived textual representation.
A video captioning model generates a textual description from the same input video, which is subsequently encoded into a video-level textual representation.
Since the caption is generated directly from 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , no external textual input is required.
As shown in Table I , the text-only variant achieves 93.18 % 93.18\% AP and 92.81 % 92.81\% AUC.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来将审查由标题产生的文字表述。
视频字幕模型从同一种输入视频中生成文字描述,后被编码为视频级别的文字表现.
由于标题直接由 V\ mathcal{V} 生成, 因此不需要外部文字输入 。
如表一所示,仅文本的变体实现93.18% AP和92.81% 92.81 ACUC。

blocks.en:
Although both representations are derived from the same video, they encode the video from different perspectives.
The visual representation encodes global spatiotemporal information, whereas the caption-derived textual representation summarizes high-level semantics such as objects, actions, attributes, and their relations.
Combining the two increases AP from 97.42 % 97.42\% to 98.81 % 98.81\% , AUC from 97.04 % 97.04\% to 98.66 % 98.66\% , and ACC from 90.30 % 90.30\% to 93.80 % 93.80\% .
These gains indicate that caption-derived textual representations provide complementary discriminative cues to global visual representations.
Accordingly, MTOR jointly models the two representations in its video-level multimodal branch G G , while fine-grained temporal dynamics are investigated next.
blocks.zh:
虽然两种表达方式都取自同名视频,但他们从不同角度对视频进行编码.
视觉表现编码了全局的spatiotal信息,而字幕衍生的文本表现则概括了高级语义,如对象,动作,属性及其关系等.
两者合并后,APP由97.42% 97.42%增至98.81% 98.81%,AUC由97.04% 97.04%增至98.66% 98.66%;ACC由90.30% 90.30%增至93.80% 93.80%。
这些成果表明,字幕衍生出的案文表述对全球视觉表述提供了补充性的歧视性提示。
因此,MTOR在其视频一级的多模式分支G中联合模拟了两种表述,接下来将调查精细的时间动态。

blocks.en: III-B Temporal Over-Regularity
blocks.zh: 三-B 时间超常

blocks.en:
To investigate temporal regularity in fine-grained visual representations, we analyze visual tokens at three levels, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a): coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability.
Each level is characterized by statistics reflecting temporal persistence and variability.
Fig. 1 (b)–(d) visualize the distributions of real and AI-generated videos under these analyses.
Across all three levels, AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability than real videos.
blocks.zh:
为了调查精致视觉表现中的时间规律性,我们从图1(a)中可以看出,在三个层面分析视觉符号:粗糙的机体间连续性,精致的机能信号通信,和帧到视频的稳定性.
每一级都有反映时间持久性和可变性的统计数据。
图1(b)-(d)对这些分析下真实和AI制作的视频的可视化发行。
在所有三个层面,AI生成的视频表现出比真实视频更强的时间持久性和减少的时间可变性.

blocks.en:
Coarse Inter-frame Continuity: We average the visual tokens within each frame to obtain a frame centroid and compute the cosine similarity between consecutive frame centroids.
Fig. 1 (b) plots the temporal mean of adjacent-centroid similarity against its standard deviation.
AI-generated videos exhibit higher mean similarity and lower temporal variation, indicating stronger inter-frame continuity.
blocks.zh:
粗体间 连续性 : 我们平均每个帧内的可视代号,以获得一个帧的中间体并计算连续帧的中间体相近性.
图1(b)按其标准偏差描绘相邻的中间体相似性的时间平均值。
AI出品的相片表现出较高的相似度和较低的时间变化,表明更强大的帧间连续性.

blocks.en:
Fine-grained Token Correspondence: We compare visual tokens between consecutive frames to characterize fine-grained temporal correspondence.
For each pair of adjacent frames, each token is matched to its most similar counterpart in the other frame, and the resulting similarities are aggregated into an adjacent-token correspondence score.
Fig. 1 (c) shows that AI-generated videos exhibit higher mean correspondence and lower temporal variation, indicating stronger and more stable token correspondence across consecutive frames.
blocks.zh:
不错的托肯通讯: 我们比较连续相框之间的视觉信号 来描述精细的时空通信
对于相邻的每对相邻相框,相邻相框的相邻相框与相框中最相近相对应的相框相匹配,所形成的相近相框被相邻相邻相框相接相框相对应相对应相对应相.
图1(c)显示,AI生成的视频显示的平均通信量较高,时间变化也较小,表明跨相继帧的符号通信更加有力和稳定。

blocks.en:
Frame-to-video Stability: To characterize temporal regularity over a broader context, we compare the visual tokens of each frame with those from the remaining frames in the video, yielding a frame-to-video similarity.
Fig. 1 (d) characterizes the temporal variation of these similarities.
AI-generated videos exhibit lower variation and smaller temporal changes, indicating more stable frame-to-video relations over time.
blocks.zh:
帧到视频 稳定性: 为了从更广泛的角度来描述时间规律性,我们把每个帧的可视信号与视频中其余帧的可视信号相提并论,得出帧与视频的相似性.
图1(d)说明了这些相似性的时间变化。
AI出品的相片呈现出更低的变异和更小的时间变化,表明随着时间推移,帧到视频的关系更加稳定.

blocks.en:
Collectively, these three analyses reveal a consistent temporal tendency in AI-generated videos, characterized by stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability.
We term this tendency temporal over-regularity (TOR), which motivates the TOR component for AI-generated video detection.
blocks.zh:
这三个分析共同揭示出AI生成的视频中持续的时间趋势,其特点是时间持久性更强,时间可变性更小.
我们称这个趋势为时间超常(TOR),它激励了AI生成的视频检测的TOR组件.

blocks.en: III-C Complementarity of Multimodal Semantics and Temporal Over-Regularity
blocks.zh: 三. 多式联运语义和时序的互补性

blocks.en: TABLE II : Mean performance comparison of the multimodal branch G G , the TOR-only variant, and MTOR across five benchmarks, measured by AP (%), AUC (%), and ACC (%).
blocks.zh: 表二: 经常预算 以AP(%)、AUC(%)和ACC(%)衡量的多模式分支G、只使用职权范围的变体和MTOR在五个基准上的均效比较。

blocks.en:
The preceding analyses reveal two distinct characteristics of the video.
The multimodal representation captures global visual and caption-derived semantics, whereas TOR characterizes temporal over-regularity reflected in fine-grained visual dynamics.
We therefore examine whether the two provide complementary cues for AI-generated video detection.
blocks.zh:
上述分析揭示出视频的两个不同特征.
多式联运的表达方式捕捉到全球视觉和字幕衍生的语义,而TOR则描述表现在精细视觉动态中的时间超常性.
因此,我们审查这两个单位是否为AI生成的视频探测提供了互补提示.

blocks.en:
Table II reports the mean performance across five benchmarks: GenVideo, EvalCrafter, VideoPhy, VidProM, and GenVidBench.
The multimodal branch G G achieves 97.26% AP, 97.17% AUC, and 89.51% ACC, while the TOR-only variant achieves 93.22% AP, 94.59% AUC, and 84.19% ACC.
By combining these two predictions, MTOR improves performance to 97.76% AP, 97.92% AUC, and 90.24% ACC.
These gains indicate that temporal over-regularity provides discriminative cues beyond the global multimodal representation.
blocks.zh:
表二报告GenVideo、EvalCrafter、VideoPhy、VidProM和GenVid Bench五个基准的平均业绩。
多式联运分行G实现了97.26%的AP、97.17%的AUC和89.51%的ACC,而只使用TOR的变体实现了93.22%的AP、94.59%的AUC和84.19%的ACC。
通过将这两种预测结合起来,MTOR的性能提升到97.76%AP,97.92%AUC和90.24%ACC.
这些进展表明,时间性超常提供了超越全球多式联运代表性的歧视性提示。

blocks.en:
These results demonstrate the complementarity between video-level multimodal semantics and temporal over-regularity.
Accordingly, MTOR combines the predictions from the multimodal branch and the TOR component through score-level fusion, as described in Sec. IV .
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,视频一级的多模式语义与时间上超常性之间是相辅相成的。
因此,MTOR将多式联运分支的预测与TOR组件通过分数级聚变相结合,如Sec. IV所描述.

blocks.zh: 图2:拟议MTOR框架概述,由视频级多模式分支,TOR组件和源校正分数聚变组成.

blocks.en: IV Methodology
blocks.zh: 四 方法

blocks.en:
Motivated by the empirical observations in Sec. III , MTOR jointly models video-level multimodal semantics and temporal over-regularity for AI-generated video detection.
The multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations, whereas the TOR component models temporal over-regularity through coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability.
The two components produce complementary detection scores, which are calibrated using source-training statistics and subsequently fused to obtain the final MTOR score.
blocks.zh:
在Sec.III中的经验观察的推动下,MTOR联合为AI生成的视频检测制作了视频级多模式语义模型和时间超常.
多式联运分支综合了全球视觉和字幕衍生的文字表述,而TOR组件则通过粗糙的帧间连续性、精细的符号对应和帧到视频的稳定性,模拟了时间超常性。
这两个组件产生互补的检测分数,这些分数通过源培训统计进行校正,并随后被熔接以获得最终的MTOR分数.

blocks.en: We evaluate MTOR on five benchmarks covering diverse video generators and data distributions, including GenVideo [ 32 ] , EvalCrafter [ 33 ] , VideoPhy [ 34 ] , VidProM [ 35 ] , and GenVidBench [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们根据五个基准评估MTOR,涵盖不同的视频生成器和数据发布,包括GenVideo [32],EvalCrafter [33],Video Phy [34],VidProM [35],和GenVid Bench [36].

blocks.en:
Training Set. We use the official training split of GenVideo as the source dataset and further divide it into source-training and source-validation subsets.
Real videos are sampled from the Youku-mPLUG dataset [ 37 ] , and synthetic videos are generated by Pika [ 38 ] .
blocks.zh:
培训设置。 我们使用GenVideo的官方训练分解作为源数据集,并进一步将其分为源培训和源验证子集.
真实视频取自Youku-mPLUG数据集样本[37],合成视频由Pika[38]生成.

blocks.en: Validation Set. We randomly reserve 20% of the source data as a stratified validation set for learning-rate scheduling, early stopping, and hyperparameter selection.
blocks.zh: 验证集. 我们随机保留20%的源数据,作为分级验证集,用于学习率调度,早期停止,以及超参数选择.

blocks.en: Testing Set. The testing set collects synthetic videos from 46 generator variants across five benchmarks, with real videos uniformly sampled from MSR-VTT [ 39 ] following GenVideo’s standard setting. • GenVideo [ 32 ] : Comprises 10 distinct test subsets spanning a diverse range of generative architectures, specifically featuring Gen2 [ 40 ] , Sora [ 1 ] , ModelScope (MS) [ 41 ] , MoonValley (MV) [ 42 ] , MorphStudio (MPS) [ 43 ] , Show-1 [ 44 ] , HotShot [ 45 ] , LaVie [ 46 ] , Crafter [ 47 ] , and WildScrape (WS) [ 48 , 49 , 50 ] . • EvalCrafter [ 33 ] : Features 14 video generator subsets, namely VideoCrafter V0.9 (Floor33), MoonValley (MV), Gen2, Gen2-December (Gen2-D), Mix-SR, HotShot-XL (HS-XL), Show-1, ModelScope (MS), LaVie-Base (LaVie-B), LaVie-Interpolation (LaVie-I), PikaLab (PKL), VideoCrafter (VC), PikaLab V1.0 (PKL-V1), and ZeroScope (ZS). • VideoPhy [ 34 ] : Incorporates 10 specialized subsets tailored for evaluating physical world dynamics and spatiotemporal consistency, which are synthesized by CogVideoX (CVX), CogVideoX-5B (CVX-5B), Dream-Machine (DM), Gen2, LaVie, OpenSora, Pika, SVD-T2I2V, VideoCrafter2 (VC2), and ZeroScope (ZS). • VidProM [ 35 ] : Encompasses 6 distinct text-to-video generation tracks derived from diverse real-world user prompts, including ModelScope (MS), OpenSora, Pika, StreamingT2V (ST2V), Text2Video-Zero (T2VZ), and VideoCrafter2 (VC2). • GenVidBench [ 36 ] : Integrates 6 highly challenging generator sets representing the contemporary frontier of state-of-the-art video synthesis, generated by MuseV, SVD, Mora, CogVideo, Sora, and Kling.

We employ “ShareGPT4Video-8B” [ 56 ] to generate video captions and “InternVideo2.5-Chat-8B” [ 57 ] to extract visual and textual representations.
For each video, T = 8 T=8 frames are uniformly sampled and resized to 448 × 448 448\times 448 .
The global visual and caption-derived textual representations have dimension D = 4096 D=4096 and are L 2 L_{2} -normalized before concatenation.
For the TOR component, K = 16 K=16 fine-grained visual tokens with dimension d = 4096 d=4096 are extracted from each sampled frame.

The multimodal MLP uses hidden dimensions of 2048 2048 , 512 512 , and 128 128 with a dropout rate of 0.5 0.5 .
It is trained using AdamW [ 58 ] with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , and a batch size of 64 64 for up to 50 50 epochs.
Early stopping uses a patience of 10 10 epochs, while “ReduceLROnPlateau” reduces the learning rate by a factor of 0.5 0.5 with a patience of 5 5 based on source-validation AUC.
The six temporal descriptors are mapped to the TOR score by a bias-free linear head optimized with binary cross-entropy and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} regularization.
The regularization coefficient is set to λ = 10 − 3 \lambda=10^{-3} , as selected on the source-validation set.

blocks.en: V-C Baselines
blocks.zh: 五-C基线

blocks.en:
To comprehensively evaluate the performance of the proposed MTOR, we compare it against 16 representative baselines, consisting of 2 image-level detectors and 14 video-level frameworks.
According to their target domains and foundational paradigms, the video-level detectors are rigorously partitioned into three primary categories:
(i) deepfake video detection methods, including STIL, FTCN, TALL, and MINTIME;
(ii) AI-generated video detection frameworks, which include learning-based networks such as AIGVDet, DeMamba, DeCoF, and NSG-VD, alongside training-free detection models such as ReStraV, D3, and STALL; and
(iii) cross-domain adapted approaches, including STPAG and LGN-Net from the video anomaly detection domain, as well as X-CLIP from the general video recognition domain, all adjusted with a binary head for synthetic video classification.
A concise conceptual overview of each baseline is detailed below: • FID [ 51 ] : Leverages a patch-shuffle mechanism to eliminate semantic artifacts for AI-generated image detection, extending to video detection by temporal average pooling. • NPR [ 52 ] : Targets CNN-specific up-sampling artifacts to expose AI-generated images, with video-level predictions aggregated via temporal pooling strategy. • STIL [ 18 ] : Capitalizes on a spatiotemporal inconsistency learning block to capture multi-directional temporal dynamics and spatial artifacts across frames. • FTCN [ 19 ] : Utilizes 1 × 1 1\times 1 spatial convolutions and a Transformer to capture both short- and long-term temporal coherence for general face forgery detection. • TALL [ 22 ] : Rearranges consecutive frames into a pre-defined thumbnail layout to efficiently capture spatiotemporal dependencies using model-agnostic backbones. • MINTIME [ 23 ] : Performs multi-identity deepfake detection by capturing spatiotemporal inconsistencies across identities and encoding face-scale contextual cues. • AIGVDet [ 31 ] : Detects AI-generated videos via a two-branch framework capturing spatial anomalies in RGB frames and temporal patterns in optical flow. • DeMamba [ 32 ] : Leverages a Mamba-based network to efficiently process long-range, frame-wise temporal dependencies for synthetic video detection. • DeCoF [ 59 ] : Identifies AI-generated videos by modeling inter-frame consistency in the visual feature space to capture temporal artifacts. • NSG-VD [ 16 ] : Exposes AI-generated videos by computing a Normalized Spatiotemporal Gradient based on probability flow conservation, and leveraging Maximum Mean Discrepancy to detect physical dynamics deviations. • ReStraV [ 14 ] : Uncovers AI-generated videos via perceptual straightening in representation space, using temporal curvature and stepwise distance. • D3 [ 15 ] : Discriminates AI-generated videos via a training-free framework by computing second-order central difference features to capture temporal artifacts. • STALL [ 17 ] : Introduces a training-free paradigm that distinguishes AI-generated videos from real ones by combining separate spatial and temporal likelihood scores into a joint probabilistic framework. • STPAG [ 53 ] : Detects AI-generated videos by adapting an anomaly detection framework that captures generative artifacts via diffusion models and optical perturbations. • LGN-Net [ 54 ] : Exposes generative artifacts by adapting a memory-augmented, local-global spatiotemporal anomaly detection framework for AI-generated video detection. • X-CLIP [ 55 ] : Employs a frozen, cross-frame attention-based spatiotemporal backbone coupled with a binary classifier to distinguish synthetic videos.
FID [ 51 ] : Leverages a patch-shuffle mechanism to eliminate semantic artifacts for AI-generated image detection, extending to video detection by temporal average pooling.
blocks.zh: FID [51]: 利用补丁-shuffle机制来消除用于AI生成的图像检测的语义学文物,通过时间平均集合扩展至视频检测.

blocks.en: NPR [ 52 ] : Targets CNN-specific up-sampling artifacts to expose AI-generated images, with video-level predictions aggregated via temporal pooling strategy.
blocks.zh: 第52页: 瞄准CNN特制的取景文物,以曝光AI生成的图像,并有通过时间集合策略汇总的视频级预测.

blocks.en: STIL [ 18 ] : Capitalizes on a spatiotemporal inconsistency learning block to capture multi-directional temporal dynamics and spatial artifacts across frames.
blocks.zh: [18]: 利用瞬息万变的学习障碍来捕捉跨帧的多向时间动态和空间文物。

blocks.en: FTCN [ 19 ] : Utilizes 1 × 1 1\times 1 spatial convolutions and a Transformer to capture both short- and long-term temporal coherence for general face forgery detection.
blocks.zh: FTCN [19]:利用1×1 1\times 1空间演化器和变形器来捕捉短期和长期的时间一致性来进行一般的面相伪造检测.

blocks.en: TALL [ 22 ] : Rearranges consecutive frames into a pre-defined thumbnail layout to efficiently capture spatiotemporal dependencies using model-agnostic backbones.
blocks.zh: [22]: 将相接帧重新排列为预定义的缩略图布局,以利用模型-不可知主干线高效地捕捉spatiotopal依赖.

blocks.en: MINTIME [ 23 ] : Performs multi-identity deepfake detection by capturing spatiotemporal inconsistencies across identities and encoding face-scale contextual cues.
blocks.zh: MINTIME [23]:通过捕捉不同身份之间的spatiopal不一致并编码面相尺度上下文提示来进行多身份深假检测.

blocks.en: AIGVDet [ 31 ] : Detects AI-generated videos via a two-branch framework capturing spatial anomalies in RGB frames and temporal patterns in optical flow.
blocks.zh: [31]: 通过两个分支框架检测出AI生成的视频,捕获RGB帧中的空间异常和光学流中的时间规律.

blocks.en: DeMamba [ 32 ] : Leverages a Mamba-based network to efficiently process long-range, frame-wise temporal dependencies for synthetic video detection.
blocks.zh: DeMamba [32]:Leverages 一个基于Mamba的网络,高效地处理长距离,帧的时空依赖,用于合成视频检测.

blocks.en: DeCoF [ 59 ] : Identifies AI-generated videos by modeling inter-frame consistency in the visual feature space to capture temporal artifacts.
blocks.zh: DeCoF [59]:通过在视觉特征空间中模拟帧间一致性来识别AI生成的视频来捕捉时空文物.

blocks.en: NSG-VD [ 16 ] : Exposes AI-generated videos by computing a Normalized Spatiotemporal Gradient based on probability flow conservation, and leveraging Maximum Mean Discrepancy to detect physical dynamics deviations.
blocks.zh: NSG-VD [16]:通过基于概率流量保护的计算出一个常态化 Spatioteal Gradient,并借助"最大平均值"来检测物理动态偏差,从而将AI生成的视频曝光.

blocks.en: ReStraV [ 14 ] : Uncovers AI-generated videos via perceptual straightening in representation space, using temporal curvature and stepwise distance.
blocks.zh: ReStraV [14] : (英语). 利用时间曲度和相继相距,通过感知直通代表空间,不覆盖AI所生成的视频.

blocks.en: D3 [ 15 ] : Discriminates AI-generated videos via a training-free framework by computing second-order central difference features to capture temporal artifacts.
blocks.zh: D3 [15] :通过无培训框架,通过计算二等中位差异特征来对AI生成的视频进行歧视,以捕捉时空文物.

blocks.en: STALL [ 17 ] : Introduces a training-free paradigm that distinguishes AI-generated videos from real ones by combining separate spatial and temporal likelihood scores into a joint probabilistic framework.
blocks.zh: [17]: 采用无培训模式,将人工智能生成的视频与真实视频区分开来,将单独的空间和时间概率分数合并为一个联合概率框架。

blocks.en: STPAG [ 53 ] : Detects AI-generated videos by adapting an anomaly detection framework that captures generative artifacts via diffusion models and optical perturbations.
blocks.zh: STAPG [53]: 通过调整异常检测框架来检测AI生成的视频,通过扩散模型和光学扰动来捕捉基因文物.

blocks.en: LGN-Net [ 54 ] : Exposes generative artifacts by adapting a memory-augmented, local-global spatiotemporal anomaly detection framework for AI-generated video detection.
blocks.zh: LGN-Net [54]: 通过对AI生成的视频检测的内存增强,局部-全球分泌异常检测框架进行再生出文物.

blocks.en: X-CLIP [ 55 ] : Employs a frozen, cross-frame attention-based spatiotemporal backbone coupled with a binary classifier to distinguish synthetic videos.
blocks.zh: X-CLIP [55] (英语). 使用冷冻的,跨帧的基于注意力的spatiotemporal骨干并配有二进制分级器来区分合成视频.

blocks.en: V-D Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: V-D 评价计量

blocks.en:
Following prior state-of-the-art methods, such as ReStraV [ 14 ] , NSG-VD [ 16 ] , DeMamba [ 32 ] , and DeCoF [ 13 ] , we adopt three widely used metrics to evaluate our approach: Average Precision (AP), Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUC), and Accuracy (ACC). AP evaluates the precision-recall trade-off via the area under the precision-recall curve, reflecting the model’s ability to precisely rank synthetic videos. AUC quantifies the overall detection capability across all possible thresholds, representing the probability that a randomly chosen AI-generated video is scored higher than a real one. ACC measures the proportion of correctly classified real and AI-generated videos.
Throughout Tables III – XIX , bold and underlined values denote the best and second-best results within each column, respectively.
blocks.zh:
按照以往最先进的方法,例如ReStraV[14]、NSG-VD[16]、DeMamba[32]和DeCoF[13],我们采用三种广泛使用的衡量标准来评价我们的方法: 平均精度(AP),接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUC)和精确度(ACC). AP通过精准回调曲线下的区域来评价精准回调的取舍,反映了模型精确地对合成视频进行分级的能力. AUC将所有可能阈值的总体检测能力量化,代表随机选择的AI生成的视频的得分高于真实的概率. ACC测量正确分类的真实和AI产生的视频的比例.
在整个表三至十九中,粗体和下划线的数值分别表示每一栏内的最佳和次最佳结果。

For baselines with officially released code, we reproduce their results using the official implementations. For methods without official implementations, we carefully re-implement them following the experimental settings in the original papers.

blocks.en: V-E 1 GenVideo
blocks.zh: V-E 1 电影

blocks.en:
Tables III and IV compare MTOR with 16 baseline methods on GenVideo in terms of AP and AUC, respectively, while Table XIII reports the corresponding ACC results.
MTOR achieves the highest mean AP, AUC, and ACC of 98.74%, 98.64%, and 93.36%, respectively.
Specifically, MTOR surpasses the strongest baseline D3 by 6.58 percentage points in mean AP.
In terms of mean AUC, our approach exceeds the second-best competitor ReStraV by 6.15 percentage points.
Furthermore, MTOR outperforms the closest competitor DeCoF by 5.76 percentage points in ACC.
blocks.zh:
表三和表四分别从AP和AUC的角度比较了MTOR和GenVideo上的16个基准方法,而表十三则报告了相应的ACC结果.
MTOR实现的最高平均AP,AUC,和ACC分别98.74%,98.64%和93.36%.
具体而言,MTOR在平均AP中超过最强基线D36.58个百分点.
就中值AUC而言,我们的方法超过了第二好的竞争对手ReStraV6.15个百分点.
此外,MTOR在ACC中的表现比最接近的竞争对手DeCoF高出5.76个百分点.

blocks.en:
The baseline methods exhibit substantial performance variations across different generator subsets.
Deepfake detectors, originally developed for facial manipulation, generally show limited transferability to open-domain AI-generated videos on GenVideo.
Image-level detectors remain competitive on certain generators, but their performance varies considerably across subsets.
For instance, NPR achieves only 21.61% AP and 18.99% AUC on the Show-1 subset, and 22.37% AP and 42.32% AUC on the LaVie subset.
blocks.zh:
基线方法显示,不同发电机子集的性能差异很大。
最初为面部操纵而开发的Deepfake探测器,一般显示在GenVideo上对开放域AI所出视频的可传输性有限.
图像级探测器在某些发电机上仍然具有竞争力,但其性能因子集而有很大差异.
例如,NPR在Show-1子集上只实现了21.61%的AP和18.99%的AUC,在LaVie子集上则实现了22.37%的AP和42.32%的AUC.

blocks.en:
At the generator level, MTOR achieves the best AP on 7 of the 10 subsets and maintains consistently high performance across different video generators.
Overall, these results demonstrate the strong cross-generator generalization of MTOR across diverse video synthesis models.
blocks.zh:
在生成器层面,MTOR在10个子集中的7个实现最佳AP,并保持不同视频生成器的一贯高性能.
总的来说,这些结果表明,MTOR在各种视频合成模型中具有强大的跨源性通论.

blocks.en: V-E 2 EvalCrafter
blocks.zh: V-E 2 电子计算机

blocks.en:
We evaluate the comprehensive performance on 14 generator subsets of EvalCrafter, where Table V , Table VI and Table XIII present the AP, AUC and ACC results, respectively.
MTOR achieves the highest mean AP and AUC of 99.27% and 99.30%, outperforming the strongest baseline FID by 3.68 and 3.88 percentage points, respectively.
It also achieves the highest ACC of 95.48%, exceeding the second-best baseline, DeCoF, by 5.73 percentage points.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了EvalCrafter的14个发电机子集的全面业绩,其中表五、表六和表十三分别列出AP、AUC和ACC的结果。
MTOR达到最高的AP和AUC中位数,分别为99.27%和99.30%,分别比最强基线FID高出3.68和3.88个百分点.
它还达到了最高ACC的95.48%,超过了第二好的基准DeCoF5.73个百分点.

blocks.en:
EvalCrafter is built from a diverse prompt set covering different semantic categories, styles, and motion settings, providing varied generated content for evaluation.
Across the 14 generator subsets, MTOR maintains AP and AUC above 97.6% on every subset.
It achieves the highest AP on 7 subsets, including a tie on Gen2-D, and the highest AUC on 8 subsets.
Its lowest performance occurs on LaVie-Interpolation, where it still achieves 97.63% AP and 97.67% AUC.
Overall, these results demonstrate the consistently strong performance of MTOR across diverse generator subsets and generated content.
blocks.zh:
EvalCrafter是由一个涵盖不同语义类别,风格和运动设置的多样的快取集所构建的,为评价提供了不同的生成内容.
在14个生成子集中,MTOR在每个子集中维持AP和AUC高于97.6%.
它在7个子集上实现了最高AP,包括Gen2-D上的平分,和8个子集上的最高AUC.
其表现最低的是拉维 -- -- 刑警组织,它仍然达到97.63%的AP和97.67%的AUC。
总体而言,这些结果表明,MTOR在各种生成子集和生成内容方面一直表现强劲。

blocks.en: V-E 3 VideoPhy
blocks.zh: V-E 3 视频 嘘

blocks.en:
To assess detection robustness under diverse physical-interaction scenarios, we conduct evaluations on the 10 subsets of VideoPhy, reporting the AP, AUC, and ACC metrics in Table VII , Table VIII , and Table XIII , respectively.
MTOR achieves the highest mean AP and AUC of 98.15% and 98.33%, outperforming the second-best baseline FID by 3.46 and 4.00 percentage points, respectively.
It also achieves the highest ACC of 90.70%, exceeding the second-ranked baseline LGN-Net by 12.63 percentage points.
blocks.zh:
为了评估不同物理交互情景下的检测强度,我们对视频光学的10个子集进行了评价,分别在表七、表八和表十三中报告了AP、AUC和ACC的衡量标准。
MTOR达到最高的AP和AUC平均比例为98.15%和98.33%,分别比第二好的基准FID高出3.46和4.00个百分点。
它还达到了最高的ACC90.70%,超过了排名第二的基线LGN-Net12.63个百分点.

blocks.en:
Among the baselines, FID achieves the highest mean AP and AUC, indicating that image-level spatial cues can remain effective on VideoPhy.
This is consistent with the visible artifacts associated with some physical failures in VideoPhy, such as inconsistent geometry and texture and unnatural object deformation.
At the same time, many physical violations involve object motion and interactions that evolve over time, making temporal behavior an important aspect of this benchmark.
MTOR maintains AP above 96.1% and AUC above 95.6% across all 10 generator subsets, demonstrating consistently strong performance across diverse video generators and physical-interaction scenarios.
blocks.zh:
在基线中,FID实现最高的平均值AP和AUC,表明图像级空间提示在VideoPhy上仍然有效.
这与VideoPhy中一些物理故障相关的可见文物是一致的,如相容的几何和纹理以及非自然物体变形等.
同时,许多物理侵犯涉及物体运动和相互作用,它们随时间演变,使时间行为成为这一基准的一个重要方面.
在所有10个发电机子集中,MTOR保持AP高于96.1%,AUC高于95.6%,显示不同视频发电机和物理交互情景的一贯强效。

blocks.en: V-E 4 VidProM
blocks.zh: V-E 4 维德ProM

blocks.en:
To evaluate detection performance on videos generated from diverse real-user prompts, we conduct experiments on the VidProM dataset.
The corresponding AP, AUC, and ACC metrics are reported in Table IX , Table X , and Table XIII , respectively.
MTOR achieves the highest mean AP and AUC of 96.41% and 96.61%, outperforming the second-best baseline DeCoF by 6.30 and 5.84 percentage points, respectively.
It also achieves the highest ACC of 86.48%, exceeding DeCoF by 1.01 percentage points.
Moreover, MTOR maintains strong performance across all six generator subsets, demonstrating robust cross-generator generalization under diverse video-generation conditions.
blocks.zh:
为了评价从多种真实用户提示生成的视频上的检测性能,我们在VidProM数据集上进行了实验.
相应的AP、AUC和ACC指标分别载于表九、表十和表十三。
MTOR实现了最高的AP和AUC平均比例为96.41%和96.61%,分别比第二好的基准DeCoF高出6.30%和5.84个百分点.
它还达到了最高的ACC86.48%,超过DECoF1.01%.
此外,MTOR保持了所有六个发电机子集的强性能,显示出在不同的视频生成条件下强力的跨生成器通用.

blocks.en:
VidProM is constructed from real-user prompts with broad semantic diversity, which often describe temporal changes and dynamic object behaviors.
This provides a semantically diverse and dynamic evaluation setting, under which the baseline methods exhibit considerable performance variations across generator subsets.
For example, DeCoF, despite achieving the strongest mean AP and AUC among the baselines, ranges from 76.27% to 99.56% in AP and from 80.14% to 99.56% in AUC.
In comparison, MTOR maintains AP above 92.2% and AUC above 92.5% across all six subsets, resulting in substantially higher mean performance.
Overall, these results demonstrate the consistent performance of MTOR across diverse generator subsets with real-user prompts.
blocks.zh:
VidProM由真实用户提示所构建,具有广泛的语义多样性,常描述时间变化和动态对象行为.
这提供了一个多样和动态的评价环境,根据这种环境,基准方法显示发电机子集的性能有很大差异。
例如,DeCoF尽管在基线中实现了最强的AP和AUC,但在AP中为76.27%至99.56%,在AUC中为80.14%至99.56%.
相比之下,在所有六个子集中,MTOR的AP维持在92.2%以上,AUC维持在92.5%以上,因此平均性能要高得多。
总的来说,这些结果表明,MTOR在具有实际用户提示的各种生成子集之间表现一贯。

blocks.en: V-E 5 GenVidBench
blocks.zh: V-E 5 源维德奔驰

blocks.en:
To assess cross-generator generalization, we conduct extensive evaluations on six generator subsets from GenVidBench.
Tables XI and XII report the AP and AUC scores across the six subsets, while Table XIII summarizes the overall ACC results.
MTOR achieves the highest mean AP and AUC of 96.24% and 96.71%, outperforming the second-best baseline D3 by 5.19 and 4.47 percentage points, respectively.
It also achieves the highest ACC of 85.18%, exceeding D3 by 2.29 percentage points.
Moreover, MTOR maintains AP and AUC above 93% across all six generator subsets, demonstrating strong robustness under substantial generator variations.
blocks.zh:
为了评估跨源一般化,我们对GenVid Bench的六个生成子集进行了广泛的评价。
表十一和十二报告AP和AUC对六个子集的分数,而表十三则总结了行政协调会的总体结果。
MTOR达到最高的AP和AUC平均比例为96.24%和96.71%,分别比第二好的基准D3高出5.19和4.47个百分点.
它还达到了最高的ACC85.18%,超过D32.29个百分点。
此外,MTOR在所有6个发电机子集中都保持AP和AUC高于93%,显示出在发电机发生巨大变化时的强性.

blocks.en:
The six subsets span diverse generation settings, including text-to-video and image-to-video generation with different resolutions and frame rates.
In particular, MuseV and SVD are image-to-video models, Mora, CogVideo, and Sora are text-to-video models, while Kling supports both settings.
These heterogeneous generation settings provide a challenging test of cross-generator generalization.
While several baselines achieve strong performance on individual generators, their results vary considerably across subsets.
In contrast, MTOR maintains a consistently high performance level across all six generators, resulting in the highest overall mean AP and AUC.
blocks.zh:
六个子集跨越了不同的生成设置,包括有不同分辨率和帧率的文本到视频和图像到视频生成.
尤其是MuseV和SVD是图像到视频模型,Mora,CogVideo,和Sora是文本到视频模型,而克林则支持两种设置.
这些多样的生成环境为跨生成者泛化提供了挑战性测试.
虽然若干基准在单个发电机上取得了强劲的性能,但其结果在各子集之间差别很大。
相比之下,MTOR在所有六台发电机中都保持了一贯的高性能水平,导致总的AP和AUC平均性能最高.

blocks.zh: 表十七:GenVideo上不同标题模型和视觉文本编码器在AP方面的结果(%)。

blocks.en: TABLE XVIII : Ablation results on GenVideo for different captioning models and visual-textual encoders in terms of AUC (%).
blocks.zh: 表十八:不同字幕模型和视觉文本编码器在GenVideo上对AUC的读取结果(%)。

blocks.zh: 表十九:GenVideo上不同标题模型和视觉文本编码器在ACC方面的结果(%)。

blocks.en: V-F Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: V-F 关系研究

blocks.en:
We conduct two sets of ablation studies to examine the key design choices of MTOR.
1) We evaluate the contributions of visual and textual representations, their multimodal combination, and the TOR component across all five benchmarks, with the results reported in Tables XIV – XVI .
2) We investigate different combinations of captioning models and visual-textual encoders on GenVideo, as reported in Tables XVII – XIX .
blocks.zh:
我们进行了两套消毒研究,以审查MTOR的关键设计选择.
(1) 我们评价视觉和文字表述、其多式联运组合以及所有五个基准的职权范围部分的贡献,结果见表十四至十六。
(2) 我们调查GenVideo上的字幕模型和可视文字编码器的不同组合,见表十七至十九。

blocks.en: V-F 1 Contributions of the Multimodal Branch and TOR Component
blocks.zh: 五-六岁 1 多式联运处和职权范围部分的贡献

blocks.en:
Tables XIV – XVI compare five variants: visual-only, text-only, the multimodal branch G G , the TOR-only variant, and the complete MTOR.
The visual-only variant achieves five-benchmark mean AP, AUC, and ACC of 94.78%, 94.25%, and 87.35%, respectively, outperforming the text-only variant in overall mean performance.
Combining the global visual and caption-derived textual representations in the multimodal branch G G substantially improves the mean performance to 97.26% AP, 97.17% AUC, and 89.51% ACC.
Compared with the visual-only variant, these correspond to gains of 2.48, 2.92, and 2.16 percentage points.
Notably, the multimodal combination improves AP and AUC over the visual-only variant on all five benchmarks, demonstrating the complementary value of caption-derived textual semantics for video-level detection.
blocks.zh:
表十四 – 十六比较了五个变体:只可视化,只文本化,多模式分支G-,只TOR变体,和完整的MTOR.
仅可视化的变体实现5个基准的AP,AUC和ACC分别为94.78%,94.25%和87.35%,在整体平均性能上超过了仅文本的变体.
将全球视觉和字幕衍生的文字表述结合到多式联运分支G,使平均性能大幅提升到97.26%的AP,97.17%的AUC和89.51%的ACC.
与仅可视化变体相比,这些变体的增益分别为2.48分,2.92分和2.16分.
值得注意的是,多式联运组合改进了AP和AUC在所有五个基准上仅可视化的变体,显示出字幕衍生的文字语义对于视频级检测的互补价值。

blocks.en:
When used independently, the TOR-only variant achieves mean AP, AUC, and ACC of 93.22%, 94.59%, and 84.19%, respectively.
Its complementary contribution becomes more evident when combined with the multimodal branch.
Compared with the individual multimodal branch G G , the complete MTOR improves the mean AP, AUC, and ACC across the five benchmarks by 0.50, 0.75, and 0.73 percentage points, respectively.
The largest gains are observed on VideoPhy and GenVidBench, where MTOR improves AP by 1.54 and 1.58 percentage points, AUC by 1.83 and 2.02 percentage points, and ACC by 2.83 and 3.32 percentage points, respectively.
Although performance decreases occur on some benchmarks, most notably on VidProM, the overall mean performance improves across all three metrics.
These results indicate that the TOR component provides complementary temporal cues beyond those captured by the multimodal representations.
blocks.zh:
在独立使用时,只使用TOR的变体分别达到AP,AUC和ACC的93.22%,94.59%和84.19%.
如果结合多式联运分支,其补充性贡献就更加明显。
与单一的多模式分支G G 相比,完整的MTOR将平均AP、AUC和ACC分别改进了0.50分、0.75分和0.73分。
在VideoPhy和GenVid Bench上发现的效益最大,其中MTOR将AP分别提高1.54和1.58个百分点,AUC提高1.83和2.02个百分点,ACC提高2.83和3.32个百分点.
虽然在一些基准,特别是在VidProM基准上,业绩有所下降,但总体平均业绩在所有三个指标上都有所改善。
这些结果表明,职权范围部分提供了补充时间提示,超出了多式联运表述所抓住的时间提示。

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : t-SNE visualizations of 10 generator subsets of the GenVideo test set: (a) Crafter, (b) Gen2, (c) HotShot, (d) LaVie, (e) ModelScope, (f) MoonValley, (g) MorphStudio, (h) Show-1, (i) Sora, and (j) WildScrape. Blue and orange points denote real and AI-generated videos, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图3:GenVideo测试集10个发电机子集的t-SNE可视化: (a) Crafter, (b) Gen2, (c) HotShot, (d) LaVie, (e) ModelScope, (f) MoonValley, (g) MorphStudio, (h) Show-1, (一) Sora, (j) WildScrape. 蓝分和橙分分别表示真实的和AI生成的视频.

blocks.en: V-F 2 Effects of Captioning Models and Visual-Textual Encoders
blocks.zh: V-F 2 说明模型和视觉文本编码器的效果

blocks.en:
To investigate the effects of caption generation and visual-textual representation on detection performance, we evaluate different combinations of captioning models and visual-textual encoders on GenVideo.
The image-level captioners include “BLIP-base” and “BLIP-large”, which generate descriptions for individual frames and are paired with CLIP-P16, CLIP-P32, XCLIP-P16, and XCLIP-P32.
The video-level captioners include “CogVLM2-Caption”, “UGC-VideoCaptioner”, and “ShareGPT4Video-8B”, which generate video-level descriptions and are paired with “LanguageBind” or “InternVideo 2.5”.
Tables XVII – XIX report the corresponding AP, AUC, and ACC results.
blocks.zh:
为了调查字幕生成和视觉文字表现对检测性能的影响,我们评价GenVideo上的字幕模型和视觉文字编码器的不同组合.
图像级标题包括“BLIP-base”和“BLIP-大”等,它们生成单个帧的描述,并与CLIP-P16、CLIP-P32、XCLIP-P16和XCLIP-P32对齐。
视频层面的字幕包括“CogVLM2-Caption”、“UGC-Video Captioner”和“ShareGPT4Video-8B”,它们生成视频层面的描述,并配有“语言Bind”或“InternVideo 2.5”。
表十七 -- -- 十九报告了相应的AP、AUC和ACC结果。

blocks.en:
Overall, configurations using video-level captioners and video-language encoders achieve higher mean performance than those using frame-level BLIP captioners with CLIP/XCLIP encoders.
For each video-level captioner, “InternVideo 2.5” consistently outperforms “LanguageBind” across all three metrics.
The improvements range from 1.45 to 4.04 percentage points in AP, 1.52 to 3.69 percentage points in AUC, and 2.86 to 7.16 percentage points in ACC.
These results indicate that the choice of visual-textual encoder has a substantial effect on detection performance.
In addition, “BLIP-large” does not consistently outperform “BLIP-base” under the same encoder, suggesting that increasing the captioning model size alone does not necessarily improve detection performance.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,使用视频级字幕和视频语言编码器的配置比使用带有CLIP/XCLIP编码器的帧级BLIP字幕的配置实现更高的平均性能.
对于每个视频层面的字幕,“InternVideo 2.5”在所有三个度量标准上都一贯优于“语言宾德”。
改进幅度为:AP的1.45至4.04个百分点;ACC的1.52至3.69个百分点;ACC的2.86至7.16个百分点。
这些结果表明,可视文字编码器的选择对检测性能有实质性影响.
此外,同一编码器下的“BLIP-大”并非一贯优于“BLIP-基”,这表明仅增加标注模型尺寸不一定能改善探测性能。

blocks.en:
The relative performance of the video-level captioners also depends on the visual-textual encoder.
When paired with “LanguageBind”, “ShareGPT4Video-8B” achieves lower mean AP and AUC than “CogVLM2-Caption” and “UGC-VideoCaptioner”.
However, when paired with “InternVideo 2.5”, it achieves the highest mean AP, AUC, and ACC of 98.74%, 98.64%, and 93.36%, respectively.
The second-best configuration, “CogVLM2-Caption” with “InternVideo 2.5”, achieves 98.72% AP, 98.56% AUC, and 93.30% ACC, trailing the best configuration by only 0.02, 0.08, and 0.06 percentage points, respectively.
Based on its best overall performance across all three metrics, we adopt “ShareGPT4Video-8B” with “InternVideo 2.5” in the final MTOR configuration.
blocks.zh:
视频级字幕器的相对性能也取决于视觉文本编码器.
当与“语言宾德”、“ShareGPT4Video-8B”配对时,AP和AUC的平均值低于“CogVLM2-Caption”和“UGC-VideoCaptioner”。
然而,如果与“国际视网膜2.5”配对,则最高的AP、AUC和ACC分别达到98.74%、98.64%和93.36%。
第二好配置,“CogVLM2-Caption”和“InternVideo 2.5”,分别达到98.72%的AP、98.56%的AUC和93.30%的ACC,分别仅次于0.02、0.08和0.06个百分点。
根据其在所有三个衡量标准方面的最佳总体业绩,我们在最后的MTOR配置中采用了“ShareGPT4Video-8B”和“InternVideo 2.5”。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 : Robustness comparison of MTOR and four representative baselines across 12 video perturbations using AP (%).
blocks.zh: 图4:使用AP对MTOR和12个视频扰动的4个代表性基线进行强力比较(%)。

blocks.en: V-G Visualization and Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: V-G 可视性和强性分析

blocks.en:
In this section, we further analyze the discriminative characteristics and practical robustness of MTOR.
Specifically, we employ t-SNE to visualize the distribution of real and AI-generated videos across the 10 generator subsets of GenVideo, providing an intuitive comparison of their separability in the representation space.
We then compare MTOR with four representative baselines under 12 practical video perturbations, covering codec compression, resolution and frame-rate changes, color-space transformation, social-media simulation, and TikTok-style post-processing.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们进一步分析了MTOR的歧视性特征和实际稳健性.
具体来说,我们使用t-SNE来直观地在GenVideo的10个生成子集中分发真实的和AI生成的视频,对它们在表达空间的可分性进行直观的比较.
然后,我们将MTOR与12个实用视频扰动下的4个代表性基线进行比较,涵盖代码压缩,分辨率和帧率变化,色相空间转换,社交媒体模拟,和TikTok风格后处理.

blocks.en: V-G 1 t-SNE Visualization
blocks.zh: V-G 1 t- SNE 可视化

blocks.en:
To visualize the distribution of real and AI-generated videos based on the multimodal representation and the temporal descriptors used by MTOR, we perform t-SNE analysis on the 10 generator subsets of GenVideo.
Let 𝐫 G \mathbf{r}^{G} denote the last hidden-layer representation of the multimodal branch G G .
For each video, we concatenate 𝐫 G \mathbf{r}^{G} with the standardized TOR descriptors 𝐝 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{d}} as 𝐫 = [ 𝐫 G ∥ 𝐝 ~ ] \mathbf{r}=[\mathbf{r}^{G}\|\tilde{\mathbf{d}}] , and project the resulting representation into a 2D space using t-SNE.
This concatenation is used only for visualization, while the final MTOR prediction is obtained through score-level fusion.
blocks.zh:
为了根据MTOR使用的多模式表示和时间描述来直观地传播真实的和AI生成的视频,我们对GenVideo的10个生成子集进行了t-SNE分析.
让 r G\ mathbf{r}^{G} 表示多式联运分支 G 的最后一个隐藏层 。
每段视频,我们用标准化的 TOR 描述符 d ~\tilde\ mathbf{d} 将 r = [r G →\ mathbf{r} [\ mathbf{r}\ mathbf{r} , 使用 t-SNE , 将生成的表示符投射为 2D 空间 。
这种凝聚只用于可视化,而最终的MTOR预测则通过分数级聚变得到.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 3 , real and AI-generated samples generally form distinguishable distributions across the GenVideo generator subsets, although the degree of overlap varies among generators.
Clear class separation can be observed on Gen2, Crafter, HotShot, ModelScope, MoonValley, MorphStudio, and Sora, while LaVie, Show-1, and WildScrape exhibit relatively more overlap near the class boundaries.
Nevertheless, real and AI-generated samples remain largely distinguishable across all subsets.
The separation patterns are consistent with the high AP and AUC obtained on these subsets in Tables III and IV .
In general, these visualizations provide an intuitive view of the discriminative structure jointly reflected by the multimodal representation and TOR descriptors.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,真实和AI生成的样本一般在GenVideo生成子集之间形成可分辨的分布,尽管不同生成者之间的重叠程度不同.
在Gen2,Crafter,HotShot,ModelScope,MoonValley,MorphStudio,和Sora上可以观察到清级分离,而LaVie,Show-1和WildScrape则在类边界附近显示出相对更多的重叠.
然而,真实的和人工智能生成的样本基本上仍然可以在所有子集中加以区分。
分离模式与表三和表四这些子集的高AP和AUC一致。
一般来说,这些可视化提供了一种直观的视角,即多式联运表述和TOR描述共同反映的歧视性结构.

blocks.en: V-G 2 Robustness to Diverse Video Perturbations
blocks.zh: V-G 2 强力到分散视频扰动

blocks.en:
To evaluate the practical robustness of MTOR under common video transformations encountered during transmission, platform processing, and post-production, we compare MTOR with FID, ReStraV, DeCoF, and D3 under 12 perturbation settings on GenVideo.
As shown in Fig. 4 , the evaluation includes H.264 compression with QP values of 23, 30, and 38; H.265 compression with QP values of 28, 34, and 40; resolution scaling; frame-rate conversion; color-space transformation; social-media simulation; TikTok stylized rendering; and TikTok heavy post-processing.
The evaluated perturbations cover both individual video transformations and compound processing pipelines, thereby providing a diverse assessment of detection robustness under practical video degradation.
blocks.zh:
为了评价MTOR在传输,平台处理和后期制作过程中遇到的常见视频转换下的实际稳健性,我们将MTOR与FID,ReStraV,DeCoF,和GenVideo上12个扰动设置下的D3进行比较.
如图4所示,评价内容包括:QP值为23,30和38的H.264压缩;QP值为28,34和40的H.265压缩;分辨率缩放;帧率转换;色相空间转换;社交媒体模拟;TikTok分层渲染;TikTok重后处理.
经评估的扰动既包括单个视频转换,也包括复合处理管道,从而在实际视频退化下对检测强度进行了多样的评估.

blocks.en:
MTOR consistently achieves the highest AP under all 12 perturbation settings, with an average AP of 98.79%.
Its performance ranges from 98.60% to 98.94%, corresponding to a variation of only 0.34 percentage points across all settings.
In comparison, the strongest baseline D3 achieves an average AP of 90.54%, 8.25 percentage points lower than MTOR.
The average AP values of DeCoF, ReStraV, and FID are 90.39%, 87.91%, and 70.98%, respectively.
blocks.zh:
MTOR在所有12个扰动设置下始终实现最高AP,平均AP为98.79%.
其性能从98.60%到98.94%不等,相当于所有场合的变化只有0.34个百分点.
相较之下,最强的基准D3平均实现90.54%的AP,比MTOR低8.25个百分点.
DeCoF、ReStraV和FID的平均AP值分别为90.39%、87.91%和70.98%。

blocks.en:
MTOR also exhibits substantially smaller performance variation across perturbations.
The AP ranges of D3, DeCoF, ReStraV, and FID are 2.30, 15.77, 16.38, and 26.94 percentage points, respectively, compared with only 0.34 percentage points for MTOR.
For example, DeCoF achieves 96.28% AP under resolution scaling but decreases to 80.51% under frame-rate conversion and 81.01% under TikTok heavy post-processing.
FID is particularly sensitive to color-space transformation, where its AP decreases to 56.04%.
By contrast, MTOR remains above 98.6% AP under every evaluated perturbation.
These results demonstrate that MTOR maintains consistently high detection performance across diverse real-world video processing conditions.
blocks.zh:
MTOR在各种干扰中的表现差异也小得多。
AP的D3,DeCoF,ReStraV,和FID分别为2.30,15.77,16.38和26.94个百分点,而MTOR只有0.34个百分点.
例如,DeCoF在分辨率缩放下实现了96.28%的AP,但在帧率转换下降至80.51%,在TikTok重后处理下降至81.01%.
FID对色彩-空间转换特别敏感,其AP下降至56.04%.
相比之下,在每次评估的扰动中,MTOR仍然高于98.6%的AP.
这些结果显示,MTOR在不同的现实世界视频处理条件中始终保持高检测性能.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we proposed MTOR for generalizable AI-generated video detection by jointly considering video-level multimodal semantics and temporal over-regularity.
The multimodal branch represented each video from both visual and caption-derived semantic perspectives, while retaining the video itself as the sole input.
Our temporal analysis further revealed that AI-generated videos tended to exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability, which we termed temporal over-regularity.
To quantify this temporal pattern, we developed the TOR component with six descriptors characterizing coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability.
The predictions from the two branches were combined through source-calibrated score fusion using only source-domain statistics.
Across five large-scale benchmarks and 46 generator variants, comparisons with 16 representative baselines demonstrated the state-of-the-art overall performance of MTOR.
Additional ablation studies confirmed the complementary contributions of the multimodal branch and TOR component, while robustness experiments showed consistently strong performance across twelve diverse video perturbations.
Overall, these results established MTOR as an effective and robust framework for cross-generator AI-generated video detection.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出通过共同考虑视频层面多模式语义和时间超常性,为通用AI生成视频检测提供MTOR.
多式联运分支从视觉和字幕衍生的语义角度代表每个视频,同时保留视频本身作为唯一的输入.
我们的时间分析还表明,人工智能制作的视频往往表现出更强的时间持久性和减少的时间可变性,我们称之为时间超常。
为了量化这种时间规律,我们开发了TOR组件,配有6个描述框间粗糙连续性的描述符,精细的纹章对应符和帧到视频的稳定性.
两个分支的预测通过只使用源域统计的源校正分数核聚变合并.
在5个大型基准和46个发电机变体中,与16个具有代表性的基准进行比较,显示了MTOR的最新总体业绩。
额外的消化研究证实了多式联运分支和职权范围部分的互补性贡献,而强健性实验显示,在12个不同的视频扰动中,一贯表现强劲。
总体而言,这些结果将MTOR确立为跨生成器AI生成视频检测的有效而有力的框架.
